entries.title: Psalms 25:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 25:2
segments: O my God, I trust in You; Let me not be ashamed; Let not my enemies triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 25:3
segments: Indeed, let no one who waits on You be ashamed; Let those be ashamed who deal treacherously without cause.

entries.title: Psalms 25:4
segments: Show me Your ways, O LORD; Teach me Your paths.

entries.title: Psalms 25:5
segments: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You [are] the God of my salvation; On You I wait all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 25:6
segments: Remember, O LORD, Your tender mercies and Your lovingkindnesses, For they [are] from of old.

entries.title: Psalms 25:7
segments: Do not remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Your mercy remember me, For Your goodness' sake, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 25:8
segments: ¶Good and upright [is] the LORD; Therefore He teaches sinners in the way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:9
segments: The humble He guides in justice, And the humble He teaches His way.

entries.title: Psalms 25:10
segments: All the paths of the LORD [are] mercy and truth, To such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 25:11
segments: For Your name's sake, O LORD, Pardon my iniquity, for it [is] great.

entries.title: Psalms 25:12
segments: Who [is] the man that fears the LORD? Him shall He teach in the way He chooses.

entries.title: Psalms 25:13
segments: He himself shall dwell in prosperity, And his descendants shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 25:14
segments: The secret of the LORD [is] with those who fear Him, And He will show them His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 25:15
segments: ¶My eyes [are] ever toward the LORD, For He shall pluck my feet out of the net.

entries.title: Psalms 25:16
segments: Turn Yourself to me, and have mercy on me, For I [am] desolate and afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 25:17
segments: The troubles of my heart have enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses!

entries.title: Psalms 25:18
segments: Look on my affliction and my pain, And forgive all my sins.

entries.title: Psalms 25:19
segments: Consider my enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

entries.title: Psalms 25:20
segments: Keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.

entries.title: Psalms 25:21
segments: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for You.

entries.title: Psalms 25:22
segments: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all their troubles!
